title: Canonical identification of affine K-injective cohomology comparison
statement: For affine f and exact adjunction a as in affineAlgebraCounitHomologyComparison, the affine K-injective cohomology comparison isomorphism may be chosen with hom equal to affineAlgebraCounitHomologyComparison f P a I n.

proof.text: The affine sections edge map is canonical and equals the mate defining affineAlgebraCounitHomologyComparison; the unbounded affine truncation argument proves it invertible in every degree.

lean.statement: theorem affine_algebra_kinjective_canonical_comparison_identification {X Y : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f] (P : SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) [P.Additive] [Limits.PreservesFiniteLimits P] [Limits.PreservesFiniteColimits P] (a : P ⊣ RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)) (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective] (hI : ∀ n : ℤ, (I.homology n).IsQuasicoherent) (n : ℤ) : ∃ e : (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I).homology n ≅ (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)).obj (I.homology n), e.hom = affineAlgebraCounitHomologyComparison f P a I n
